instruction: HOVER ON EACH STEP TO LEARN MORE

nodes.label: User Support Services
nodes.tooltipDescription: Helps users understand T&E and find and engage the best services for their needs, and MOD to understand market health.

nodes.label: Integration Services
nodes.tooltipDescription: Custodian of user experience, assuring technical quality and seamless interaction of individual services.

nodes.label: Management Services
nodes.tooltipDescription: Ensures Defence T&E is performing as expected and continues to meet Defence’s evolving needs by managing & influencing T&E Defence-wide.

steps.tooltipDescription: Accelerates and optimises UK T&E R&D investment and de-risks STEP investment.

nodes.label: T&E SERVICE
nodes.tooltipDescription: Provides common enablers of T&E, where necessary to deliver the Portfolio’s mission. Accessible to all service providers within the marketplace to meet the needs of the User.

steps.tooltipDescription: A combination of STEP-Funded T&E Services (Critical MOD owned or retained T&E capabilities, assets and services) and Other T&E Services (UK and international network of services, facilities and ranges available for T&E)

subSteps.tooltipDescription: Overseas government‑owned ranges and test services, including modelling and simulation (M&S), for which the MOD already has established access agreements, as well as contractor‑owned overseas ranges and test services (including M&S), are made available for use by the wider marketplace.
